lines.say: I ignored the old man. I ran home.
The kitchen light was on. I looked through the window.
A man sat at my table. In my chair. Eating my wife's cooking.
My shirt. My watch. My scar on his hand.
He looked up, straight at the window.
And he smiled, like he had been waiting.
He lifted one finger to his lips.
Then my phone rang in my pocket.
